messages.author: 1b43c17009f890d6
messages.subject: Error in file.path
parts:
Sorry for cross-posting in Shiny - Web Framework for R  group as well, but I am desparate:

I am getting the error noted when trying to deploy to shinyapps.io

The application runs fine locally and I get this error even when trying to deploy the "stock" Old Faithful histogram app (without modification).
Here is the entire error from the deploy tab:
Preparing to deploy application...DONE
Uploading application bundle...Error in file.path(shinyappsConfigDir(), "locale.dcf") : 
  could not find function "shinyappsConfigDir"
Calls: <Anonymous> ... localeCacheFile -> normalizePath -> path.expand -> file.path
Execution halted
Anyone else having this issue? Is it related to the maintenance?

messages.author: e84e7628b5f8a3e1
messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] Error in file.path
parts:
It looks like you are using the publish button in RStudio. 

I think we had a bad merge in the rsconnect package (the rsconnect packaged is used by the IDE which will be replacing the shinyapps package soon) that we just fixed.

You can update by doing:

devtools::install_github('rstudio/rsconnect')

-Andy
